name: Ghost Eye
source:
A presence from beyond torments the tenants of a house in the suburbs. Join Luar as he performs his first solo job as a medium. Explore a home inhabited by a group of distinctive characters, open your eye to communicate with the afterlife, and help the tenants return to a peaceful life.

[Translated from [url=https://justabard.itch.io/ghost-eye]itch.io[/url]]
